predicates.name: mycelium_phi_vs_neural_phi_correlation
predicates.tiers: identical structure to P-1 with mycelium spike-train
predicates.independence: reported as independent verdict; combined in N-23 composite gate

tiers.PASS: LZ(spike|stim=high-complex) > LZ(spike|stim=low-complex) at p<0.01 paired AND linear regression slope LZ vs stim-Shannon-entropy positive at 95% CI
tiers.WEAK: trend in correct direction but not significant
tiers.FAIL: no monotonic relationship OR inverted slope
tiers.REVERSE_FAIL: LZ saturates at near-maximum across ALL stim levels (substrate is producing noise, not encoding)

tiers.PASS: rel-dPhi >= 0.05 across all 4 family axes (Hexad/Law/Phi/SelfRef) when single tube/bundle severed; effect persists >= 30 min
tiers.FAIL: <2 axes affected OR effect dissipates within 5 min (artefact window)
tiers.REVERSE_FAIL: Phi INCREASES post-ablation by >= rel +0.05 in any family axis (substrate encoding the experimenter, not the stim)

tiers.PASS: r(Phi_k_physarum, Phi_k_mycelium) >= 0.50 across 16 matched stim states
tiers.REVERSE_FAIL: r negative AND |r| >= 0.30 (anti-correlated, encoding orthogonal directions)

composite_gate.definition: (P-1 AND P-2) AND P-3 AND P-4 AND P-5

levels.N23_STRONG: all 5 PASS, P-1 and P-2 STRONG-tier
levels.N23_WEAK: 3 PASS or any WEAK; no FAIL
